name: Cornell University
summary: Private Ivy League research university in Ithaca, New York, with both endowed and state-contract colleges. Its Dyson School offers a BS in Applied Economics and Management inside the SC Johnson College of Business.

internationalTuition.notes: Tuition for out-of-state students at any Cornell college, including all international students.

scholarships.name: Cornell need-based aid for international students
scholarships.eligibility: International admission is need-aware; admitted international students who applied for aid and show need receive a package meeting 100% of demonstrated need.
